sentences.en: Investigators are running a probe into what caused the crash.
sentences.zh: 调查人员正在调查事故原因。

sentences.en: The European Space Agency's probe, Schiaparelli, has crashed on Mars.
sentences.zh: 欧洲航天局的探测器‘夏帕雷利’在火星着陆时坠毁。

sentences.en: Parker Solar Probe will largely be alone on its journey.
sentences.zh: 帕克太阳探测器将在太空中大部分时间独自航行。
